title: Laravel 14 Adds a defaults Method to Eloquent Models
content:
Laravel 14 adds a defaults() method to Eloquent models, so default attribute values can use config, feature flags, and dates instead of constant expressions.

The post Laravel 14 Adds a defaults() Method to Eloquent Models appeared first on Laravel News.
